### Can AI replace a UX researcher?

No. AI can speed setup, moderation, transcription, and synthesis, but humans must design the method, recruit the right sample, protect participants, inspect primary evidence, interpret context, and communicate uncertainty.

### Are AI testers the same as real users?

No. Synthetic testers may help debug a study flow or generate hypotheses, but they cannot validate real demand, usability, trust, comprehension, or purchasing behavior.

### What are the best TheySaid alternatives?

Survicate suits established multichannel feedback programs, SurveyMonkey AI offers a broad survey ecosystem, and Kraftful Surveys GPT is a much lighter question-drafting aid.

## What TheySaid is

TheySaid combines several feedback methods in one product. Teams can ask users to complete product tasks while sharing their screen and voice, run conversational interviews, collect structured survey answers, or place short feedback prompts in a website or customer journey.

AI helps create the study, moderate sessions, ask follow-up questions, transcribe responses, identify themes, calculate usability measures, produce clips, and draft recommendations. Distribution options include share links, email, embeds, popups, QR codes, a participant panel, and enterprise integrations.
